title: Attention Is All You Need
abstract: The paper introduces the Transformer model, a novel neural network architecture based solely on attention mechanisms, eschewing recurrence entirely. This approach allows for more parallelization and has led to significant advancements in tasks such as machine translation.

key_contributions.title: Transformer Architecture
key_contributions.description: A deep learning model that relies entirely on self-attention mechanisms, enabling efficient parallelization and improved performance in sequence-to-sequence tasks.

key_contributions.title: Scaled Dot-Product Attention
key_contributions.description: An attention mechanism that computes the attention weights using the dot product of queries and keys, scaled by the square root of the key dimension.

key_contributions.title: Multi-Head Attention
key_contributions.description: An extension of the attention mechanism that allows the model to focus on different positions of the input sequence simultaneously, capturing various aspects of the data.

key_contributions.title: Positional Encoding
key_contributions.description: A technique to inject information about the position of tokens in the sequence, since the model lacks inherent recurrence or convolution.

impact: The Transformer model has become the foundation for many state-of-the-art models in natural language processing, including BERT, GPT, and others.
It has enabled significant improvements in machine translation, text generation, and various other NLP tasks.
The architecture's parallelizability has allowed for training larger models more efficiently.
